native_reference.cuda: CUDA C++20, nvcc O3, AOT sm_120, no PTX image
native_reference.scope: Generic simulation, full protocol and complete replay capture. Live WASM policies remain in the judge host. No learning, training, student, competitive bot or private data.
native_reference.performance: No full CUDA workload or paired profiling overhead claim.
native_reference.verification: Clean-export host/CPU/CUDA builds; both-order CPU packed-replay and per-turn-points agreement; unchanged generic source and exact NativeBegin/Advance/Apply device instruction sections inherit original accepted runtime evidence. No fresh extracted-library CUDA execution.
